raw_segments.text: Nestor was sitting over his wine, but the cry of battle did not escape him, and he said
"'What noble matchyon is the meaning of all this?
The shouts of men fighting by our ships grow stronger and stronger.
Stay here, therefore, and sit over your wine, while fair Hecaimt heats you a bath and washes
the clotted blood from off you.
I will go at once to the lookout station and see what it is all about.'"
